name: Nowarion AI
author: nowarion

sections.description:
Nowarion AI connects your WordPress admin area to the Nowarion AI service. After entering your Nowarion plugin token, authorized WordPress users can generate SEO article title ideas, heading structures, full article drafts, AI images, and review generation history from wp-admin.

The plugin is designed for site owners, editors, and content teams who already use a Nowarion account. A Nowarion account and plugin token are required for generation, credit balance checks, AI model lists, image options, and credit package information.

Main features:

  • Connect a WordPress site to a Nowarion account with a plugin token.
  • View account connection status and available credit balance.
  • Generate article title ideas from the Makale AI screen.
  • Generate article heading structures.
  • Generate article drafts and save them as WordPress draft posts.
  • Generate and import AI images from the Nowarion image library.
  • Use the Hızlı Makale screen for fast article workflows.
  • View generation history inside WordPress.

The plugin does not load remote JavaScript or remote CSS assets. All admin assets used by the plugin are included locally in the plugin package.

External services

This plugin connects to the Nowarion AI service to provide AI generation, account status, credit balance, model options, image options, image library, and credit package functionality.

Service provider: Nowarion

Service endpoint used by the plugin:
https://app.nowarion.com/api/api

Related service pages:

  • Main service website: https://nowarion.com
  • Terms of Use: https://nowarion.com/termsofuse/
  • Privacy Policy: https://nowarion.com/policy/

When the service is contacted:

  • When an administrator saves and tests the plugin token.
  • When the plugin checks the connected Nowarion account and credit balance.
  • When the dashboard retrieves credit package information.
  • When an authorized user generates title ideas.
  • When an authorized user generates article headings.
  • When an authorized user generates a full article draft.
  • When an authorized user checks a pending article generation result.
  • When an authorized user retrieves image options or the Nowarion image library.
  • When an authorized user generates or imports an AI image.

Data that may be sent to the service:

  • WordPress site URL.
  • Nowarion plugin token.
  • Plugin version.
  • Article title.
  • Focus keyword and extra keywords.
  • Selected language, article type, writing tone, and generation options.
  • Selected AI provider/model and model-related options.
  • Requested title count or heading count.
  • Heading structure and image assignment data used for article creation.
  • Image prompt and image generation options.

Data that may be returned by the service:

  • Account status and basic account information.
  • Credit balance and credit usage data.
  • Available AI providers, models, languages, tones, article types, and image options.
  • Generated title ideas.
  • Generated heading structures.
  • Generated article content.
  • Generated image data or image library items.
  • Credit package information and store links.

A Nowarion plugin token is required before generation features can be used. By entering a plugin token and using the generation features, the site administrator authorizes the plugin to communicate with the Nowarion AI service.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the nowarion-ai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin ZIP from the WordPress admin plugin installer.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Nowarion AI > Genel Durum in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter your Nowarion plugin token and save it.
  5. Confirm that the account status and credit balance are displayed.
  6. Use Makale AI or Hızlı Makale to generate content.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Nowarion account?

Yes. A Nowarion account and plugin token are required for generation, credit balance checks, AI model options, and credit package information.

Does the plugin send data to an external service?

Yes. The plugin sends the data required to provide AI generation and account/credit functionality to the Nowarion AI service. See the External services section for details.

Does the plugin load remote JavaScript or CSS?

No. The plugin admin JavaScript and CSS files are included locally in the plugin package.

Can generated content be saved as a WordPress post?

Yes. Generated article content can be transferred into WordPress as a draft post.

Who can use the plugin screens?

The dashboard and history screens require administrator capabilities. Article generation screens require WordPress post editing capabilities.
